This administrative guideline is intended only to outline the skilled trades placement procedure. All other provisions of Appendix A outside of the sequential placement order will govern skilled trades placement (e.g. Refusal of Job Offers, Relocation, Seniority Return to Former Community, etc.). If for any reason an interpretation of Appendix A conflicts with the above sequential skilled trades placement procedure listed herein, this administrative guideline will govern.

Very truly yours,

D. Scott Sandefur

Vice President
